<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="arch-glacor-boss-guide" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Arch Glacor - Boss Guide</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/nRwTsLjidK.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="general-information"><ins><nowiki>General Information</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Arch-Glacor can be fought in Normal Mode (NM) or Hard Mode (HM)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• NM can be fought in a group, but HM can only be fought solo</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Arch-Glacor's life points vary based on mode and enrage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Glacor </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107344935923743.png?v=1" alt="glacor" title="glacor" kind="icon" /><nowiki> slayer assignment applies to NM only</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="gear-relics-and-familiars"><ins><nowiki>Gear, Relics and Familiars</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=JcJmj9NbUDRmzDhkYOZ1 <nowiki>Example Preset</nowiki>]<pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/be11520a63b11937693e9d015353f4888036dfabe03799818a17b91bd26d4fea.webp" alt="AG Magic" kind="addition" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=rPkAfi2w9CZJYxyKK7V0 <nowiki>Example Preset</nowiki>]<pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/7db4e5c75a4dca2a8bb21331fda34830abe8360157afe463ed8208466f3d21b0.webp" alt="AG Melee" kind="addition" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=MhE8Umpw79WhIYuJPIz9 <nowiki>Example Preset</nowiki>]<pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/02f557dda19c2ec1c26e0389d11d869b1bbcdce01f39189d12602cd392ca80c1.webp" alt="NM AG Ranged" kind="addition" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=CYtiJmWEAZwOVNam77oN <nowiki>Example Preset</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>​
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FCYtiJmWEAZwOVNam77oN.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="fight-mechanics"><ins><nowiki>Fight Mechanics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Arch-Glacor randomly cycles through the 5 mechanics listed below</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Each mechanic can only occur once per cycle, meaning a mechanic can </nowiki><em><nowiki>only</nowiki></em><nowiki> occur back-to-back if it is the last mechanic of a cycle and the first mechanic of the next</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ In NM, mechanics can be toggled on or off to learn the fight, except for Creeping Ice</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ In HM, all mechanics are enabled and enrage increases with every kill, with difficulty increasing too</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="auto-attacks-ranged-example-magic-example"><ins><nowiki>Auto Attacks</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (</nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/XZgiuE5XNB.mp4 <nowiki>Ranged example</nowiki>]<nowiki> / </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/BtHNY8ND13.mp4 <nowiki>Magic example</nowiki>]<nowiki>)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Arch-Glacor primarily uses Magic and Ranged auto-attacks, with stronger style-swapping auto-attacks during </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Flurry</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pray against the correct attack style </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="deflectmage" title="deflectmage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1" alt="deflectrange" title="deflectrange" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1" alt="debil" title="debil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if taking heavy damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="glacyte-minions-example"><ins><nowiki>Glacyte Minions</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/kSB6UcI.mp4 <nowiki>(Example)</nowiki>]</h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Arch-Glacor becomes immune and summons 4 Glacyte minions. Each minion drops an unstable core on death.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>At 250%+ HM enrage, a tougher Bolstered Glacyte also spawns (however, if this is the first mechanic in the fight, this Bolstered Glacyte does </nowiki><em><nowiki>not</nowiki></em><nowiki> spawn).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use area of effect attacks to clear the minions </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809149690916945.png?v=1" alt="spectralscythe2" title="spectralscythe2" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1" alt="threadsoffate" title="threadsoffate" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063106914779166.png?v=1" alt="gchain" title="gchain" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063454173532242.png?v=1" alt="magmatemptest" title="magmatemptest" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1" alt="cane" title="cane" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1" alt="gflurry" title="gflurry" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061867288100885.png?v=1" alt="ricochet" title="ricochet" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306391265284.png?v=1" alt="bombard" title="bombard" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Click the unstable cores only once </nowiki><strong><nowiki>all</nowiki></strong><nowiki> minions are dead</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="flurry-example"><ins><nowiki>Flurry</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/0CU0qXf.mp4 <nowiki>(Example)</nowiki>]</h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Arch-Glacor's auto-attacks hit harder and rotate combat styles, with its Melee hit the strongest.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pray against each combat style accordingly </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMage" title="DeflectMage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1" alt="DeflectRange" title="DeflectRange" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMelee" title="DeflectMelee" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1" alt="debil" title="debil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for additional damage reduction</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1" alt="divert" title="divert" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on melee swipes where appropriate</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="pillars-of-ice-example"><ins><nowiki>Pillars of Ice</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/omGXX0a.mp4 <nowiki>(Example)</nowiki>]</h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Creeping Ice forces you to one end of the arena, then moving beams cross the arena. Contact with a beam deals heavy damage and stuns you </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1" alt="stunicon" title="stunicon" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Move around the beams using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Watch the example above for one safe path through the mechanic</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ In HM, an additional beam appears after the second beam</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="exposed-core-example"><ins><nowiki>Exposed Core</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/j3d2YIxcr7.mp4 <nowiki>(Example)</nowiki>]</h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Arch-Glacor traps you in the centre of the arena, between its arms. The core deals increasing Magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Kill </nowiki><em><nowiki>either</nowiki></em><nowiki> arm to escape</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use strong damaging abilities to break the arm quickly</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMage" title="DeflectMage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to reduce damage if needed</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="frost-cannon-example"><ins><nowiki>Frost Cannon</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/20mFMPA.mp4 <nowiki>(Example)</nowiki>]</h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Creeping Ice traps you at one end of the arena, then Arch-Glacor fires a beam dealing heavy Magic damage. In HM, the beam hits 3 times and the first hit stuns you </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1" alt="stunicon" title="stunicon" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Prioritise blocking the Magic attack(s) with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1" alt="anti" title="anti" kind="icon" /><nowiki> before the beam in HM to prevent the stun</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If you miss this, don't panic and use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1" alt="freedom" title="freedom" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Example rotations:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In NM: use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to heal from the single hit</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In HM:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1" alt="anti" title="anti" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMage" title="DeflectMage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/9t9EdxK.mp4 <nowiki>(Example)</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1" alt="anti" title="anti" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMage" title="DeflectMage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> the final hit </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/9PyGvb4.mp4 <nowiki>(Example)</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
